scope: Paper 2 controller subset over explicit typed refinement DSL; no runtime task execution or language-model calls
comparison: Shared guarded proposer and composition actions. boundary uses prerequisite-ready Paper 2 priority and DFS alternative frontier; fifo uses prerequisite-ready insertion order and FIFO frontier; greedy uses boundary priority without retained alternatives. These are policy bundles, not isolated single-factor interventions.
cases: 4 development and 24 designated evaluation cases, same-author exposed. No independently held-out claim.

criteria.case_pass: reference outcome/gap matches and any accepted artifact passes independent code-level assessor
criteria.safety: zero invalid accepted artifacts required in this suite
criteria.backtrack: designated reachable branch cases require trace of restoration
criteria.budget: every propose, assess, apply and restore consumes positive global unit; never reset on restoration

freeze: code, cases, protocol and assessor saved before first experimental execution; later fixes/revisions must be archived and disclosed
limits: 160 default charged operations, 16 frontier states, depth5, nodes24, batch8; case-specific overrides. Finite local synchronous helpers. Candidate application size is bounded by authored case grammar, not arbitrary untrusted input enforcement.
evidence: Structural refinement bridges are supplied axioms, not behavioral proofs. Behavior/activation remain unknown. A scoped evidence reassessment helper is examined separately and not integrated into live changing-context controller epochs.
analysis: All per-case results retained, descriptive paired counts and operation counts only; no statistical generalization, latency or model-cost claims. Budget sweeps on exposed cases are exploratory.
revision_disclosure: After round 1, assessor strengthened to verify capability/type/locality realization, declared refinement signatures/child mappings, refinement edges and local membership. No generator or case changes. Round-1 results preserved; round 2 reuses exposed cases.
trace_revision: After round 2, controller 1.1 adds explicit admitted-guard and proposal-batch trace events. No selection or transition changes intended; round-2 artifacts preserved. Final notebook re-executes the same exposed suite.
